'''Karii''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] under the tutelage of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dajjun]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he and his master, along with several other Jedi and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[4-B4]], were dispatched by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on a [[Mission to Kailion|mission]] to recover a data droid belonging to the [[Sheyasti Trade Syndicate]] that would prove that the Syndicate was [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] supplies to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They acquired it in the [[Kailion caves|caves]] of [[Kailion]] but were forced to fight a number of creatures in the cave while making their escape.
